title: Things I Believe
summary: Lee Robinson's principles for engineering and leadership, including shipping speed as a superpower, truth-seeking through exposure hours, communication and writing as core skills, and hiring based on growth potential and learning opportunity.
when-to-read: Read this when seeking guidance on career development, shipping strategy, communication practices, or leadership philosophy grounded in practical experience. If you need specific techniques for code quality, testing, or system design, consult software-architecture or code-quality articles instead; this is about mindset and principles rather than implementation details.
